description: Use this first when a user or agent sees a real economic situation but is not yet sure whether it is a controlled opportunity, a buyer/operator demand requirement, a consequential bottleneck, or a capability-provider case. This tool is intentionally cross-sector and low-friction. It does not submit data, create rights, infer authority, or treat public information as a mandate.

commercial_intent.description: Whether the economic principal is only exploring or can approve a bounded paid verification after scope and price are confirmed. This never authorizes an automatic charge.

country_location.description: Country, region, corridor, market, site or service area when known.

current_workaround.description: How the problem is handled now, including incumbent supplier, internal workaround, waiting, road freight, manual review, excess capacity or other substitute.

decision_horizon.description: Optional deadline or time-to-decision, e.g. 'within 45 days'.

economic_consequence.description: Observed spend, delay, lost output, capacity shortfall, budget, demand, revenue effect or other consequence. Unknown is acceptable.

economic_value.description: Optional bounded money/value expression such as '$2.4M annual spend', '₦50M/month lost output', or 'unknown'. This is user-supplied and not independently verified.

economic_value_state.description: Choose the strongest state actually supported now; do not upgrade indicative value into committed money.

evidence_state.description: Best current description of the evidence basis; this is not independent verification.

recurrence.description: How often the economic consequence or spend recurs when known.

relationship_to_signal.description: Choose only what is true now. Unknown is valid and must not be upgraded.

signal_summary.description: What is happening economically, what outcome is blocked or needed, and why the signal may matter.

name: triage_economic_signal
title: Triage a real-world economic signal without claiming project rights
